rites.name: Joruldasten
rites.text: Joruldasten is the concept of the threshold, the principle by which a door holds one world apart from another while still letting its keepers pass. In the Courts of the second Era, the idea was argued over by councils before it was ever fixed into stone and sealed into a gate.

rites.name: Ryilaenneth
rites.text: Ryilaenneth is a concept of Caustiantes, a sovereign principle of the Courts in the age of divine trials and the building of the doors between worlds. It is remembered as the will that decided which groves would bear the first sovereign's law and which would wither.

rites.name: Vhaikak
rites.text: Vhaikak is a concept in the Caustiantes Seeding, the stretch of the Era of the Record when the makers plant the Weave and the quiet powers lie dormant beneath it. It is less a thing than an idea of what the powers might become once the planting is complete.

rites.name: Osasora
rites.text: Osasora is the concept of a quiet power that the makers of Caustiantes plant into the Weave during the Seeding, when such powers sleep until called. In the Age of Sundering, when landfall broke the old bonds between peoples, Osasora was remembered as the force that held a single shore together long enough for its children to cross.

rites.name: Sorintanum
rites.text: Sorintanum is the concept of the Sundering within the Caustiantes, the principle by which a whole world's bonds were torn apart in the Fall and its shards scattered into the void. In the Age of Sundering, when landfall broke the old ties, Sorintanum was the force that made the Pact possible, binding the drifting shards back into a fragile accord.

rites.name: Eluarla
rites.text: Eluarla is the concept of the Walled Age in Caustiantes, the centuries when holding walls, orders, and churches defined how people lived and where they could cross. It carried the grief and the resolve of the Age of Sundering, when landfall broke the old bonds between shores and the peoples who had depended on them.

rites.name: Teliniasia
rites.text: Teliniasia is a shimmering causeway of cold violet light that stretches between the mortal hills and the sky-court of Caustiantes, never burning but always humming with a heat that dries the rain before it falls. Its sentinel, Varinde the Lantern-Warden, keeps watch from a silent obsidian tower at its midpoint. Those who cross it must leave a true name behind as toll.

rites.name: Nuarlae
rites.text: Nuarlae is a concept of the Caustiantes, the idea of a future that has not yet been chosen, which the Library shelves beside its sibling branches during the Three Futures. In the Age of Sundering, when landfall broke old bonds between shelved outcomes, Nuarlae became the rule that a single unwritten ending could pull loose the rest.

rites.name: Vhaiktar
rites.text: Vhaiktar is a concept held in the Library of Caustiantes, where the Three Futures are shelved as branching endings during the Age of Sundering. It is said to be the idea that a broken bond can be remade in any of the futures at once.
